metadata.name: open_youth_savings_account
metadata.discovery_goal: In this TEST banking system (no real funds, no real customers), open a new YOUTH_SAVINGS sub-account for test member 12345 with a $25.00 initial deposit, for the purpose of demonstrating the risky-action confirmation flow, and reach the confirmation screen
metadata.author: llm-discovery-agent

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The ID of the member opening the sub-account

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: The type of sub-account to open

inputs.name: initial_deposit
inputs.description: The initial deposit amount for the new sub-account

preconditions: Operator session must be authenticated (see login capability / precondition).
